entities.name: 2013 Aguadilla UAP incident
entities.description: Two objects recorded on infrared video by a U.S. Customs and Border Protection aircraft over Rafael Hernandez Airport near Aguadilla, Puerto Rico, on April 26, 2013, which AARO resolved in March 2025 as probably a pair of sky lanterns.

claims.v: not a member of the intelligence community
claims.quote: AARO is not a member of the intelligence community.

AARO assesses with moderate confidence that the objects depicted in the video are
sky lanterns.
The objects' apparent high speed is attributable to motion parallax.

Rather, the sensor could
not distinguish the objects from their environment due to a lack of thermal contrast between
them and the ocean.

AARO considered this interpretation unlikely, as the STK
reconstruction demonstrates that the objects moved in a straight line at wind speed over land.

AARO does not concur with this assessment, because it is unlikely that an IR sensor
could detect reflected moonlight.
